accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a medical or osteopathic college accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Committee on Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools in conjunction with the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, or the Bureau of Professional Education of the American Osteopathic Association

school_approval_basis.quote: graduated from a medical or osteopathic college accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Committee on Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools in conjunction with the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, or the Bureau of Professional Education of the American Osteopathic Association

credential_pegged.quote: graduated from a medical or osteopathic college officially recognized by the jurisdiction in which it is located for the purpose of receiving a license to practice medicine in all of its branches

kind.quote: has completed 24 months of postgraduate clinical training, as approved by the Department

exams.name: Examination authorized by the Department
exams.notes: Examinations held at least twice per year; applicant must pass within 3 years of filing application; after 5 failures in any jurisdiction, further examinations are barred until additional formal professional study is completed.
exams.quote: Pursuant to Department rules, as required, pass an examination authorized by the Department to determine the applicant's fitness to receive a license.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) Steps 1, 2 CK, and 3

exams.quote: who has passed Step 1, Step 2 Clinical Knowledge, and Step 3 of the United States Medical Licensing Examination as required by this Act

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Beginning on January 1, 2020, the fee for renewal of a license for a resident or nonresident is $181 per year.

required.quote: The Department shall promulgate rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Act that require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year.

hours_per_period.quote: require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year

period_years.quote: require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year

available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, issue a license by endorsement to any person who is currently licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches, or a chiropractic physician, in any other state, territory, country or province

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in another state/territory/country/province; must satisfy IL educational requirements; requirements of other jurisdiction must be substantially equivalent to IL requirements; good moral character; physical/mental/professional capacity; criminal background check; no prior failed IL exam.
requirements.quote: issue a license by endorsement to any person who is currently licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches, or a chiropractic physician, in any other state, territory, country or province, upon the following conditions

exists.quote: There is hereby created the Illinois State Medical Board. The Medical Board shall consist of 17 members, to be appointed by the Governor

national_association.quote: the Bureau of Professional Education of the American Osteopathic Association

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

title_protection.quote: attaches the title Doctor, Physician, Surgeon, M.D., D.O. or D.C. or any other word or abbreviation to his or her name indicating that he or she is engaged in the treatment of human ailments or conditions as a business

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine in all of its branches or treats human ailments without the use of drugs or operative surgery including, but not limited to, treatment or diagnosis of any physical or mental ailments or conditions including, but not limited to, deformities, diseases, disorders, or injuries without a valid license under the laws of this State shall be sentenced as provided in Section 59.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony under US law including plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States of any crime that is a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, of alcohol, or of any other substances which results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for, or procuring, a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statement regarding skill or efficacy of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement regarding their skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment, or remedy prescribed by them at their direction in the treatment of any disease or other condition of the body or mind.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing another person or organization to use their license to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing another person or organization to use their license, procured under this Act, to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction against the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction against a license or other authorization to practice as a medical doctor, doctor of osteopathy, doctor of osteopathic medicine, or doctor of chiropractic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this Act or its rules or final administrative action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this Act or of the Medical Practice Act prior to the repeal of that Act, or violation of the rules, or a final administrative action of the Secretary, after consideration of the recommendation of the Medical Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the prohibition against fee splitting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the prohibition against fee splitting in Section 22.2 of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of terms of probation or conditions placed on the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Medical Board that the registrant after having his or her license placed on probationary status or subjected to conditions or restrictions violated the terms of the probation or failed to comply with such terms or conditions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, or distributing controlled substances for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, giving, or self-administering any drug classified as a controlled substance (designated product) or narcotic for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs or devices to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure by secret method or refusing to divulge treatment method upon demand
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine, or the treating, operating, or prescribing for any human condition by a method, means, or procedure which the licensee refuses to divulge upon demand of the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct including sexual misconduct related to licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act including, but not limited to, commission of an act of sexual misconduct related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice as a physician, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file required medical reports or failure to report suspected abuse or neglect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing or recording, or inducing another person to omit to file or record, medical reports as required by law, or willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse or neglect as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Named as perpetrator in indicated report of child abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or corporations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional patronage by any corporation, agents, or persons, or profiting from those representing themselves to be agents of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging or filing false statements for collection of fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful and continued overcharging for professional services, including filing false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice or behavior demonstrating incapacity or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior which demonstrates incapacity or incompetence to practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness or disability resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental illness or disability which results in the inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness or loss of motor skill resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill which results in a physician's inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert licensing examinations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examinations administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating physician-patient confidentiality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between physician and patient except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding and abetting an unlicensed individual in the practice of a licensed profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding and abetting an individual not licensed under this Act in the practice of a profession licensed under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating state or federal laws relating to controlled substances, legend drugs, or ephedra
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating State or federal laws or regulations relating to controlled substances, legend drugs, or ephedra as defined in the Ephedra Prohibition Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction or peer review body
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse final action taken against them by another licensing jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report surrender of license while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department surrender of a license or authorization to practice as a medical doctor, a doctor of osteopathy, a doctor of osteopathic medicine, or doctor of chiropractic in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse judgment, settlement, or award from a liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide copies of medical records as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide copies of medical records as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the Department with relevant legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the Department, its investigators or representatives, relevant information, legally requested by the Department after consultation with the Chief Medical Coordinator or the Deputy Medical Coordinator.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by this law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into an excessive number of collaborative agreements with advanced practice registered nurses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into an excessive number of written collaborative agreements with licensed advanced practice registered nurses resulting in an inability to adequately collaborate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a licensed advanced practice registered nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a licensed advanced practice registered nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Compassionate Use of Medical Cannabis Program Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Compassionate Use of Medical Cannabis Program Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected abuse or neglect of an eligible adult
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into an excessive number of collaborative agreements with physician assistants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into an excessive number of written collaborative agreements with licensed physician assistants resulting in an inability to adequately collaborate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a physician assistant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a physician assistant.

definition_quote.value: practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery
definition_quote.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

methods_authorized.quote: holds himself or herself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of physical or mental ailments or conditions including, but not limited to, deformities, diseases, disorders, or injuries of human beings

drug_authority.value: Any person licensed under this Act to practice medicine in all of its branches shall be authorized to purchase legend drugs requiring an order of a person authorized to prescribe drugs, and to dispense such legend drugs in the regular course of practicing medicine.
drug_authority.quote: Any person licensed under this Act to practice medicine in all of its branches shall be authorized to purchase legend drugs requiring an order of a person authorized to prescribe drugs, and to dispense such legend drugs in the regular course of practicing medicine.

license_status_types.quote: Any licensee who notifies the Department, in writing on forms prescribed by the Department, may elect to place his or her license on an inactive status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must have been trained outside the US, have education certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), have passed USMLE Steps 1, 2 CK, and 3, maintain an unencumbered license from another country, and not be licensed in any US state or territory. After January 1, 2025, a limited license pathway is available.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: "International medical graduate" means a medical graduate (i) who has been trained in a country other than the United States; (ii) whose education has been certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates; (iii) who has passed Step 1, Step 2 Clinical Knowledge, and Step 3 of the United States Medical Licensing Examination as required by this Act; (iv) who maintains an unencumbered license from another country; and (v) who is not licensed to practice medicine in any state or territory of the United States.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has completed 24 months of postgraduate clinical training, as approved by the Department

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A person who engages in the practice of telemedicine without a license or permit issued under this Act shall be subject to penalties. Telemedicine means the performance of medical activities, including rendering written or oral opinions concerning diagnosis or treatment of a patient in Illinois by a person in a different location as a result of transmission of individual patient data by telephonic, electronic, or other means of communication.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person who engages in the practice of telemedicine without a license or permit issued under this Act shall be subject to penalties provided in Section 59.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The Department may issue a temporary permit to an applicant who is licensed to practice as a physician in another state. The temporary permit will authorize the practice of providing health care to patients in this State

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches may enter into collaborative agreements with no more than 7 full-time equivalent physician assistants

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A collaborating physician may, but is not required to, delegate prescriptive authority to a physician assistant as part of a written collaborative agreement, and the delegation of prescriptive authority shall conform to the requirements of Section 7.5 of the Physician Assistant Practice Act of 1987.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A collaborating physician may, but is not required to, delegate prescriptive authority to a physician assistant as part of a written collaborative agreement, and the delegation of prescriptive authority shall conform to the requirements of Section 7.5 of the Physician Assistant Practice Act of 1987.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches may enter into collaborative agreements with no more than 7 full-time equivalent physician assistants

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief administrator or executive officer of any health care institution licensed by the Illinois Department of Public Health shall report to the Medical Board when any person's clinical privileges are terminated or are restricted based on a final determination

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: "Program of care, counseling, or treatment" means a written schedule of organized treatment, care, counseling, activities, or education, satisfactory to the Medical Board, designed for the purpose of restoring an impaired person to a condition whereby the impaired person can practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this Section, the Medical Board, upon a showing of a possible violation, may compel any individual who is licensed to practice under this Act or holds a permit to practice under this Act, or any individual who has applied for licensure or a permit pursuant to this Act, to submit to a mental or physical examination and evaluation, or both

investigational_drug_protection.quote: The Department shall not revoke, suspend, place on probation, reprimand, refuse to issue or renew, or take any other disciplinary or non-disciplinary action against the license or permit issued under this Act to practice medicine to a physician: (1) based solely upon the recommendation of the physician to an eligible patient regarding, or prescription for, or treatment with, an investigational drug, biological product, or device
